entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-30
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • dotnetup: simplify or remove the admin mode command gate #56859
  • dotnetup: select release files by exact filename instead of substring matching #56858
  • _CreateComHost target up-to-date checks are incorrect #56856
  • macOS single-file self-contained published Mach-O binaries all have same LC_UUID causing local network access problems #56855
  • Static web assets: Release build/publish of a net10.0-macos Web SDK project fails - manifest only written per RID, read from the RID-less folder #56854
  • Bug 3089610: [11.0.100-rtm.26522.141] [6.0.441-servicing.26523.5][10.0.115-servicing.26522.139][10.0.404-servicing.26526.111] All UnitTest failed to run with error "vstest.console failed to connect to testhost" #56850
  • [aw] Issue Monster Assigner produced no safe outputs #56847

Closed

  • Concurrent Tool Installation can fail #51831
  • File-based apps: dotnet run reuses cached build when a required dependency DLL is missing #56747
  • Native companion asset declaration and transitive content flow for file-based C# apps ('#:ref') #56642

PullRequests

Created

  • Stop filing Issue Monster Assigner workflow-failure issues #56866
  • Add a dry-run dotnetup preview/GA release pipeline in C# #56865
  • Build daily and preview dotnetup variants together (with placeholder GA) #56864
  • Do not delay exit waiting for telemetry #56863
    Servicing-approved
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Preserve published tool packages when metadata publication fails #56862
    Servicing-consider
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Serialize concurrent tool package installations #56861
    Servicing-consider
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Check each referenced project once in dotnet format #56857
    backport
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0.2xx' => 'main' #56853
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #56849

Merged

  • [release/11.0.2xx] [dotnet watch] Align mobile WebSocket authentication with WASM browser tools #56860
    Servicing-consider
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0.1xx' => 'release/11.0.2xx' #56816
  • `dotnetup` `admin` mode specification #56603
  • Add `dotnetup <> install` under `admin` mode MVP #56664
  • Preserve MTP diagnostics and truthful CI reporting #56851
  • [dotnet watch] Align mobile WebSocket authentication with WASM browser tools #56722
  • Support required MTP artifact processing and global CI summaries #56852
  • Simplify Hot reload browser tools availability check #56818
    Servicing-consider
  • File-based apps: handle missing build outputs #56787
    Area-run-file
  • File-based apps: allow metadata on `#:include` #56392
    Area-run-file

Updated

  • [release/11.0.2xx] Avoid redundant dataflow in security analyzers #56581
    Servicing-consider, Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • [release/11.0.2xx] Reduce CA1508 analysis cost for local-function calls #56580
    backport, Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Improve dotnetup list output #56797
  • [dotnet watch] Reload the project graph for the selected device and runtime identifier #56723
  • Print merged MTP code coverage summaries #56805
  • Honor MSBuild -mt in dotnet run preparation #56837
  • Update common project templates to net12.0 #56404
  • Simplify dotnetup uninstall to remove command-line requirements #56799
  • Resolve named dotnetup channels to the greatest eligible release #56800
  • Unify dotnetup repository requirements and install-spec resolution #56798
  • Honor configured NuGet sources for package discovery #55848
  • Add CDN publishing pipeline for dnup #56844
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Check each referenced project once in dotnet format #56728
    Servicing-consider
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #56846
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #56840
